findings.summary: First failing invariant is narrowed to command0 source-response retention after proven line/dispatch/ready.
Dispatch responses=1 is documented as necessary but insufficient for user-visible generated-root command-input acceptance.
The selected follow-up is the bounded source-response-retention core task.
Kernel command-loop or target proof source changes are deferred unless core evidence proves they are necessary.
Same-shaped timing/wait/cursor retries and dispatch-only/tail-only acceptance remain rejected.
No hardware run is needed for this source/static contract.
